en.name: Pius VIII
en.summary: A short-reigning pope whose twenty months in office were spent navigating a Europe increasingly resistant to papal authority.
en.body: Francesco Saverio Castiglioni's brief pontificate addressed rising religious indifferentism and disputes over mixed Catholic-Protestant marriages in Germany, while contending with revolutionary unrest spreading across Europe following the July 1830 revolution in France. His death after less than two years left many of these tensions for his successor Gregory XVI to confront.
